_about: Sequence diagrams as options, compared with pros and cons
title: Keeping mobile users signed in

context.callout: Access tokens expire after **15 minutes**. Today the app logs the user out when that happens — 31% of support tickets last month.

prompt: How should the app refresh its token?

options.label: Rotating refresh token
options.recommended: Industry default; a stolen token is useless after one use

preview.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as App
  participant S as Auth
  A->>S: refresh_token ① 
  S-->>A: access + refresh ② 
  Note over S: ① revoked
  A->>S: refresh_token ② 
  S-->>A: access + refresh ③

cons: Two tabs refreshing at once can race

preview.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as App
  participant S as API
  A->>S: request + session
  S-->>A: response + extended expiry
  Note over A,S: idle 30 days → expired

sequenceDiagram
  participant A as App
  participant K as Keychain
  participant S as Auth
  A->>K: read credentials
  K-->>A: Face ID ✓
  A->>S: login
  S-->>A: new access token
